name: Levi Lucas
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “My first font was copied from a van parked outside our old flat.” People around the steps at Pier Beach know Levi by a small Saturday habit. Levi watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I copied the typeface for a design job and never credited the woman holding the chalk.
appearance: Levi has a high puff tied with plain cord, a round face with a pronounced chin, and a favorite piece of clothing, a red windbreaker. It usually goes with a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. When somebody else has the floor, Levi counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Levi prefers exact instructions at work and pleasant surprises at home. The two standards occasionally collide, especially when a relative thinks dropping by counts as notice.
agenda: To credit the chalk writer on the next design job.
family: Gabriel Ibrahim is Levi’s parent’s cousin. Levi calls about good news first. Gabriel is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *The return of a witness*, Gabriel says, “I care for the aunt. We set a lunchtime end so a hard visit can still have an ordinary evening after it.”
connections: Emery Gordon. They document the hidden menu and credit the original chalk writing.

reactions.situation: An old customer wants a debt to stay between two people
reactions.response: Levi keeps the amount beside the old customer's name off the public board.

reactions.response: Levi asks one close relative to check in privately instead of stopping the party for a public inquiry.
